spans.s: sadaka, cf. upari-sadaka, explained as ‘the upper region’ (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXXI. p. 234).
sadā-sevā, cf. Tamil sadā-servai, sadā-sevai (SII 1; SITI); constant service; permanent service.
sādyaskra (EI 22; CII 3; etc.), name of a sacrifice.
sa-daṇḍa-doṣa (EI 23), ‘together with [the right to] levy fines for crimes’; the meaning of doṣa is really doubtful in the context.
sa-daṇḍa-nigraha (EI 24), refers to the king's power to punish [culprits] by fines or corporal punishment.
sa-daś-āpacāra , same as sa-daś-āparādha; cf. Ind. Ep., p. 397.

sa-daś-āparādha (EI 27), also quoted as sa-daś-āpacāra; ‘together with the right to punish and realise fines for the ten offences (murder, theft, etc.)’; epithet of gift village; cf. sahya-daś-āparādha probably meaning that the crimes committed in the gift village should not be punished by the king.
